div.div:
Why pull instead of push? The VM has no public IP (VirtualBox NAT), so GitHub cannot reach it.
The VM polls GitHub instead: no SSH secrets, no tunnel, and a red build is never deployed.

text.tspan: Why pull instead of push? The VM has no public IP (VirtualBox NAT), so GitHub cannot reach it.
The VM polls GitHub instead: no SSH secrets, no tunnel, and a red build is never deployed.
